judged_text: members passes params[:offset].to_i straight into the SQL offset without clamping, so a negative offset (e.g. offset=-1) generates invalid SQL and a 500 on the public /groups/:name/members endpoint. adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members` the diff sets `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then calls `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation/clamping (app/controllers/groups_controller.rb). A request like `?offset=-1` will produce a negative SQL OFFSET; on Postgres this is invalid and can raise an error, returning a 500. The JS client clamps offsets, but the public endpoint can still be hit directly with a negative offset.
